title: Chain lubrication
text: Lubricate a clean bicycle chain to reduce friction.

title: Chain maintenance
text: Clean dirt from a bicycle chain before lubricating each link.

title: Tyre pressure
text: Use a pressure gauge to check bicycle tyres.

title: Puncture repair
text: Patch the inner tube to repair a bicycle puncture.

title: Plant watering
text: Check soil moisture before watering an indoor plant.

title: Dry soil
text: Water a houseplant when the upper soil layer feels dry.

title: Plant light
text: Place a sun-loving plant near a bright window.

title: Plant pots
text: Choose a pot with drainage holes.

title: Bread storage
text: Freeze sliced bread in a sealed bag to preserve it longer.

title: Bread thawing
text: Thaw frozen bread slices at room temperature.

title: Bread baking
text: Let dough rise before baking a loaf.

title: Rice cooking
text: Simmer rice in water until tender.

title: Passwords
text: Create a unique password for each online account.

title: Password manager
text: Use a password manager to store unique account passwords.

title: Screen brightness
text: Reduce monitor brightness in a dim room.

title: Keyboard cleaning
text: Unplug a keyboard before brushing away dust.

title: Train tickets
text: Buy a train ticket before boarding where required.

title: Train platforms
text: Check the departure board to find your train platform.

title: Bus stops
text: Wait at a marked bus stop for the correct route.

title: Walking routes
text: Use a street map to plan a walking route.
